note: Salt study, nioac2 fallback. Input rule: each species is entered in the form it exists in water under the study conditions, and max_deprotonations says how far it may go below that form. Ni(OAc)2: acetic acid with 1 deprotonation (HOAc/OAc- both real, pKa ~ 4.8). tHQ listed first (reuse between the two salts), up to 1 deprotonation(s). Ni(II) high-spin; square-planar excluded because d8 Ni(II) there is low-spin and only high-spin is modelled.
